hint.publicHost: Host name or IP address players connect to, without http:// and without a port (each server adds its own port). Shown on the fleet, on each server's page and on the join page.
none: Without a public address the join page cannot tell players where to connect.
perServer: A server can have its own address: set it on that server's edit page; it wins over this one.
saveFailed: The address could not be saved.
subtitle: How players reach the game servers
